--- text
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy do|g
--- width
20
--- keys
Down
--- expect
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog|
--- note
At width 20 the line wraps to three visual rows: "The quick brown fox ",
"jumps over the lazy ", and "dog". The caret sits on the last visual row,
which has no row below it. CodeMirror's cursorByLine, when a vertical move
cannot leave the current row, falls back to moveToLineBoundary in the same
direction, so Down moves to the end of the row, which here is the end of the
document. This matches macOS moveDown on the last line. The caret must reach
offset 43, not stay put at offset 42.
